entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Nacatl leonin planeswalker native to Naya, whose spark ignited after his brother's death; later calmer and wiser.

entities.name: Jazal
entities.description: Ajani's brother, whose death filled Ajani with fury.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who showed Ajani the volcanic red magic of Jund.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker off doing his own thing, unrelated to the Alara storyline.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane that was sundered into five shards.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara suffused with red, white, and green mana; Ajani's homeland.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara adjacent to Naya, source of volcanic red magic.

entities.name: The Sundering
entities.description: The breaking of Alara into five shards.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Leonin people of Naya, Ajani's people.

events.summary: After discovering his brother was killed, Ajani's spark ignites and he makes his first planeswalk to Jund.
events.quote: after Ajani discovered his brother was killed, Ajani's first planeswalk was to the "adjacent" shard of Jund.

events.summary: On Jund Ajani meets Sarkhan Vol, who shows him volcanic red magic that lets him externalize his rage.
events.quote: On Jund Ajani met the planeswalker Sarkhan Vol

events.summary: Young Ajani, full of rage, searches for who was behind his brother's death.
events.quote: letting nothing stand in his way as he discovers who was behind his brother's death

relations.quote: the death of his brother, Jazal

relations.note: showed Ajani a new kind of magic
relations.quote: who showed him a new kind of magic
Ajani is actually a Nacatl leonin native to Naya
